1.text: “Mbese uzi igihe amasha yo mu bitare abyarira?Cyangwa wabasha kugaragaza igihe imparakazi ziramukwa?

2.text: Washobora kumenya amezi zimara zihaka?Cyangwa se uzi igihe zibyarira?

3.text: Zirahēra zikabyara abana bazo,Kwerera kwazo kugashira.

4.text: Abana bazo barakomera bagakurira mu gasozi,Bagacuka bakigendera ntibazigarukeho.

6.text: Izo nahaye ubutayu ngo zibubemo,N'igihugu cy'ubukuna nkaziha ho ubuturo bwazo?

7.text: Zanga urusaku rwo mu mudugudu,Kandi ntabwo zumva urwamu rw'uziyoboye.

8.text: Zizerera mu misozi aho zirisha,Zikahuka zikajya gushaka intohera z'ubwatsi.

9.text: “Mbese imbogo yakwemera kugukorera?Cyangwa yaguma mu kiraro cyawe?

10.text: Wabasha kuyizirikisha umugozi ngo uyihingishe?Cyangwa yasanza mu bikombe igukurikiye?

11.text: Wayiringira kuko imbaraga zayo ari nyinshi?Cyangwa wayiharira umurimo wawe?

12.text: Wakwiringira yuko yasarura imyaka yawe,Ikayirunda ku mbuga yawe?

13.text: “Amababa y'imbuni iyakungutana ubwibone,Ariko se amababa yayo n'amoya yayo si ubwiza gusa?

14.text: Kuko amagi yayo iyatera ku butaka,Agashyuhira mu mukungugu,

15.text: Ikibagirwa yuko ikirenge cyabasha kuyahwata,Cyangwa yuko inyamaswa yabasha kuyakandagira.

16.text: Igirira ibyana byayo nabi nk'ibitari ibyayo,Nubwo imirimo yayo ari ubusa,Ntibiyitera ubwoba,

17.text: Kuko Imana yayimye ubwenge,Kandi ntiyihe kujijuka.

19.text: “Mbese ni wowe wahaye ifarashi imbaraga?Cyangwa ni wowe wayiteye umugāra uhungabana ku ijosi ryayo?

20.text: Ni wowe wayihaye gusimbuka nk'inzige?Ubwiza bwo kwivuga kwayo butera ubwoba,

21.text: Ikaraha mu gikombe ikishimira imbaraga zayo,Ikajya gusanganira ingabo.

22.text: Isuzugura ubwoba nta cyo itinya,Ndetse ntabwo ihindukira ngo ihunge inkota.

23.text: Ikirimba kijegerera hejuru yayo,Umuheto n'icumu rirabagirana, n'agacumu.

24.text: Uburakari bwayo bukaze butuma iyogoza isi,Kandi iyo yumvise ijwi ry'impanda ntirituma ihagarara.

25.text: Iyo yumvise impanda hose irivuga,Kandi ikarehera intambara ikiri kure,Guhinda kw'abagaba n'urusaku.

26.text: “Mbese agaca kagurukishwa n'ubwenge bwawe,Iyo karamburiye amababa yako aherekeye ikusi?

27.text: Igisiga gitumbagira ku itegeko ryawe,Rikaba ari ryo rituma cyarika hejuru?

28.text: Kiba mu bitare kikarikaho,No mu bihanamanga mu masenga yabyo.

29.text: Gihigisha ijisho ryacyo rishaka icyo gifata,Amaso yacyo akabibona biri kure.

30.text: N'ibyana byacyo binyunyuza amaraso,Kandi aho intumbi ziri ni ho kijya.”
